text:
sophie: Quick heads-up — can we do a 30m run-through tomorrow 10:00am PT for the marketplace launch orchestration and SI onboarding hooks? I want to walk the sequence end-to-end and lock owners for press, landing pages, and SI tech handoffs.

kevin: +1. I can cover landing + CDN cutover notes. will need final hero copy by EOD today. @sophie can you confirm legal-approved phrasing? :memo:

ajay: I can cover SI tech on-boarding (API keys, webhooks, example terraform). FYI a few SI contracts need a short addendum on telemetry — putting that on my plate.

maria: I'll take press coordination and embargo logistics. who is the backup for press if i'm OOO during rollout? @olivia? :sweat_smile:

olivia: Yup I can be backup for press. Also can own partner-facing FAQ and the landing page partner callouts.

kevin: To save time tomorrow, here's a quick checklist I want us to validate in the run-through:

```
- Press: embargo window, press list, quote owners, embargo release time
- Landing: hero + partner logos, partner sign-up CTA, analytics tags
- SI tech: sample terraform, API keys, SSO instructions, on-call rotation
- Hardware partners: sample benchmark blurbs and compliance bullets
- Legal: joint announcement approvals + partner signoff list
```

sophie: perfect. @ajay can you confirm the sample terraform repo path and whether the SI onboarding scripts require container images?

ajay: repo is at `github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-samples/si-onboard`. scripts use a small container (gcr.io/redwood/si-helper:v1.2). nothing heavy. I'll add a short README for the ops team.

maria: Press embargo note: partners requested embargo until 2026-06-09T16:00Z. we should align internal deploy windows to not auto-publish any landing content before that.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging -> prod cutover window is scheduled for 2026-06-09 17:00 UTC. Automated deploys will be paused 30m prior.

olivia: Can someone own partner co-marketing assets (1-pager + social kit)? We need formatted logos (SVG + PNG) and a short partner blurb per SI.

sophie: assigning: @kevin landing assets (logos), @olivia partner blurbs + social kit, @maria press embargo ownership, @ajay SI tech + telemetry addendum. I'll update the runbook after the meeting.

kevin: One more ask: confirm the CDN purge procedure and cache TTLs for hero image updates. don't want stale logos during cutover.

ajay: noted. adding CDN purge command to the runbook: `curl -X POST https://internal-cdn/api/purge -H "Authorization: Bearer $CDN_TOKEN" -d '{"paths": ["/partners/*"]}'`

maria: Awesome. If we can cover the checklist in the 30m tomorrow and agree on owners, we'll be ready to move into dry-run next week.

sophie: Great — calendar invite sent. agenda: 1) run checklist, 2) confirm assets + repos, 3) confirm embargo sync and fallback. Bring any blockers. :rocket:
